supportingText: Start with a 15-minute first visit in normal clothes; no workout is required, and Sandy schedules your coached first class afterward.

generalPath.nextStep: Sandy recommends and schedules the coached first class afterward

steps.title: Reserve Your Free Intro
steps.subtitle: First visit before class
steps.description: Request your visit online. Pick your preferred student lane (Kids, Teens, Adults) and general schedule preferences.

steps.title: Meet Sandy for your first visit
steps.subtitle: One-visit starting plan
steps.description: Tour the mats, review safety, discuss goals, and set the starting plan. The general path schedules class afterward; the specialized youth path can combine both during one visit.

steps.title: Choose the right first class
steps.subtitle: Matched, coached first class
steps.description: The general first visit uses normal clothes and requires no workout. Specialized youth requests plan for 60–75 minutes and arrive 20 minutes early in clean athletic clothing. Adults receive class-specific scheduling guidance.

steps.title: Attend Your First Class Free
steps.subtitle: Coached Learning Experience
steps.description: Step onto the mat for a calm, guided introduction to Jiu-Jitsu with zero obligation to enroll.
